Hi,

Welcome to my YouTube channel.

My name is Tomasthevet, I am Veterinary Surgeon, living and working in London. 
I specialise in small animals like cats and dogs and have a keen interest in emergency and critical care. 
I also enjoy surgery and help in a dog rescue. 
Come along with me so I can show you a bit of the vet world 😉 

Ps: some of my videos are not for the faint hearted
